Manjunath MURUGAN 
Senior Business Analyst | Financial Markets 
Noisy-le-Grand, France | 9176398910 | manjunathmurugan50@gmail.com LinkedIn: 
www.linkedin.com/in/profilemanjunathmurugan 
Fully Authorized to work in France | Availability – Immediate 
SUMMARY 
Senior Business Analyst with 4+ years in requirements and  Agile delivery, built on 8+ years 
in financial operations. Skilled in eliciting and documenting business and data rules (pricing, 
reference data, corporate actions, regulatory reporting EMIR), mapping field -level 
specifications and data lineage, defining acceptance criteria, and maintaining traceability 
through UAT to release—reducing manual effort and operational risk. 
SKILLS 
• Business Analysis: Requirements Gathering, Business Requirements Document 
(BRD), User Stories, Business Logic Analysis, Gap and Root Cause Analysis. 
• Methodology: Agile Methodology (Scrum) & Backlog Prioritization. 
• Domain Expertise: Trade Lifecycle, Reference Data Management, Pricing, Corporate 
actions, regulatory reporting (EMIR), Data Reconciliation and working knowledge of 
clearing, custody and settlement processes. 
• Technical & Data Tools: SQL (Data validation & extraction), Excel (advanced), JIRA, 
SharePoint, Confluence, HP ALM, Bloomberg and Refinitiv (Reuters). 
• Standards: ISO 20022 and SSI SWIFT data (MT541, MT543). 
PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE 
Senior Business Analyst | PwC | Chennai | May 2022 - January 2024 
• Led the end -to-end business analysis for the EMIR Refit implementation for the 
Exchange-Traded Derivatives (ETD) asset class, performing gap analysis against 
newly released DTCC technical specifications. 
• Translated complex regulatory updates into detailed field -level functional 
specifications, structured user stories, and measurable Acceptance Criteria to map 
data lineage for engineering teams. 
• Conducted technical walkthroughs of the new reporting logic for Compliance and 
Business teams to secure formal signoffs, and guided developers throughout Agile 
sprints to ensure compliance with DTCC specs. 
• Partnered with the QA team to review and refine field -level test cases for robust 
validation, while maintaining dedicated Confluence frameworks to track project 
progress and document business rules. 
Senior Business Analyst | BNP Paribas ISPL | Chennai | July 2019 - May 2022 
• Drove BA scope for the pricing platform transformation with the Product Owner, 
delivering high-integrity data feeds to downstream Fund accounting systems. 
• Designed validation rules and control mechanisms to strengthen data governance and 
reduce operational risk across pricing workflows. 
• Participated in UAT/NRT: prepared datasets, executed test cases against ACs, and 
documented defects with full traceability to user stories. 
• Validated system enhancements by executing SQL queries for data extraction and 
validation to ensure functional integrity of financial data. 
• Automated pricing feeds from market data vendors, reducing manual efforts by 25%. 
Senior Reference Data Analyst | Barclays Shared Services | Chennai | October 
2015 - June 2019 
• Owned the functional integrity of reference data and SSI setups, driving 
straight-through processing (STP) and directly reducing trade fails. 
• Reconciled accrued interest for fixed -income instruments in the static data system 
against downstream accounting/settlement systems; corrected day-count and coupon 
setup to prevent settlement/NAV impacts. 
• Resolved data mismatches and managed static data changes for corporate actions in 
collaboration with external vendors. 
• Served as the primary functional liaison between the Chennai delivery centre and 
global business hubs and trained junior analysts. 
Senior Associate Intraday Pricing | BNP Paribas GSO | Chennai | September 2011 - 
October 2015 
• Ensured intraday prices for securities are fed into downstream Fund accounting 
platforms to drive daily NAV accounting and prevent discrepancies in financial 
reporting. 
• Managed the pricing of instruments impacted by different corporate action events, 
ensuring accurate valuation for downstream fund accounting platforms. 
• Automated pricing workflows and functioned as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) for 
team transitions between Hub locations. 
• Reduced manual errors by 30% and improved turnaround time for pricing updates 
through enhanced operational efficiency. 
EDUCATION 
• MBA (Finance) - SRM University, India – 2011 
• Bachelor of commerce (B.com) - Madras University, India - 2009 
LANGUAGES 
• English - Full Professional Proficiency (C1) 
• Français - Débutant (cours intensif en cours)
